lines.text: The Philistines gathered their forces at Aphek, and David and his men marched behind them with Achish.
Achish told the commanders he had found no fault in David, the servant of King Saul, since he defected.
The angry commanders told Achish to send David back, fearing he would turn adversary and win back Saul's favor.
Achish told David to go in peace, because the Philistine leaders approved of him, though Achish found him upright.

wrong_details.wrong: the Philistine leaders approved of him
wrong_details.true: the Philistine leaders did not find him good

lines.text: David and his men rose early to return to the land of Judah, while the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
